facts.fact: 走两英里明知是坏主意仍走：左大腿肌肉打颤、义肢窝皮肤灼烧——读者首次从她视角确认义肢
facts.anchor: the muscles in my left thigh began trembling from the extra strain and the skin around my prosthetic socket started burning

facts.fact: 不肯等救援：一车牛奶压着 June 的烘焙、餐馆早餐客、杂货店补货——更是农场赔不起的钱
facts.anchor: Every hour those deliveries sat undelivered was another hour June Whitaker couldn’t bake

facts.fact: 他的修车外套太大太暖（雪松、香料、机油味），停止发抖后她仍没脱下——自己都觉得不该但没脱
facts.anchor: The mechanic’s jacket hung heavily around my shoulders, still holding some of his body heat beneath the faint scent of cedar, spice, and motor oil.

facts.fact: 陌生人的关心令她不适；但 Beau 看她的眼神不是「无助」而是「疯了」——她把这两者分得很清
facts.anchor: He had looked at me like I was crazy.

facts.fact: 咬指甲的习惯源于童年：母亲总「答应要来」却从不出现——她坐在牧场台阶上陪 Pops 等一辆永远不来的车
facts.anchor: The habit had started when I was little, back when my mother would promise she was coming and I still believed her.

facts.fact: 农场收入真相：Pops 死后六个月，区域配销商以不足 30 天通知断约（大乳企压价抢量）；自此每个本地客户都不能丢
facts.anchor: the distributor dropped us with less than thirty days’ notice.

facts.fact: 镇上不知道的三件事：义肢、农场濒临倒闭、有的月份她延后给自己发钱保帮工工资准时
facts.anchor: some months I delayed paying myself so the ranch hands could receive their checks on time.

facts.fact: 车库墙上的老照片：Walter 居中、Pops 在旁——手正搭在那辆如今抛锚的黑卡车引擎盖上；照片里是童年那种满不在乎的大笑，不是临终几个月的疲笑
facts.anchor: Pops was beside him, with one hand resting on the hood of the black truck currently sitting broken in their garage lot.
